Rodrigo Gomez-Fell was invited to speak on two panels at the New Zealand Aerospace Summit's
InFocus sessions in Christchurch: one on Earth observation for New Zealand's climate and
economic resilience, and one on Antarctica as a testbed for aerospace technology. Fellow
panellists included Wolfgang Rack. Both panels are listed on the
[Teaching](../teaching.qmd#lectures) page.
